answer: In this PoA network, reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so influence requires sustained honest service rather than a brief burst of favorable reports. EigenTrust factorization and reciprocity-weighted transitivity keep freshly spawned Sybil identities near-zero in eigenvector centrality; isolated clusters cannot bootstrap trust or pass consensus, even if they form a knoll around a relic or claim the zenith.
